description: Generate an image with AI (FLUX) and commit it into the app's repo. Costs credits. Use for hero images, backgrounds, illustrations. The file is committed at the given path (e.g. assets/hero.jpg), replacing a file already there, and a rebuild is triggered; reference it in the code afterwards. The prompt is sent to Black Forest Labs (EU endpoint).

path.description: Target path in the repo, e.g. assets/hero.jpg (.png for PNG)
